(tabs)/analytics.note: Includes an all-time populated-data variant rendered from the 133-moment E2E archive.

(tabs)/history.note: Includes populated and expanded-filter variants rendered from the 133-moment E2E archive.

(tabs)/settings.note: PERSONALIZE shows the emotion check-in reminder entry and "Manage guiding belief" with its count of every belief carrying a guiding belief or a reminder. Captured from the committed synthetic archive fixture (15 beliefs).

belief-library.note: Lists suggested and authored beliefs, hides Edit/Remove for suggested ones, and keeps their reminder controls. Captured from the committed archive fixture after a real Settings restore.

belief-system-catalog.note: A bare deep link has no active reflection actor context. Reach this screen through a staged reflection and belief-system selection.

belief-system-editor.note: A bare deep link has no active reflection actor context. Reach this screen through a staged reflection and belief-system selection.

belief-system.note: A bare deep link has no active reflection actor context. Reach this screen by continuing a staged reflection.

guiding-belief.note: A bare deep link has no active reflection actor context. Reach this screen by continuing a staged reflection.

index.note: The root route is an XState-to-Router synchronization entry and does not render a standalone screen from a bare deep link.

leitsatz-reminder.note: Includes preview, focused-notification, and success-origin schedule-picker variants.

reflection.note: Captured through the real Today emotion-star interaction, including a keyboard-open variant.

reminders.note: Captured through Settings with both empty and active emotion check-in reminder states.

success.note: A bare deep link has no completed reflection actor context. Reach this screen by completing a staged reflection.
